神经退行性疾病.title: Transcriptomic and Lipidomic Profiling of Human iPSC-Derived Microglia Reveals TREM2-Dependent and -Independent Processes
神经退行性疾病.abstract: TREM2 has been implicated in AD as a critical regulator of microglial functions and loss of function mutations in TREM2 increases one's risk of developing AD. Given the diverse functional roles of TREM2, we sought to unravel how it affects downstream pathways using human iPSC-derived microglia-like cells (iMGLs) derived from TREM2 knockout (KO) and isogenic control lines and assessing the response to oligomeric amyloid-{beta} 42 (oA{beta}42). While previous studies have primarily used fibrillar A{beta}, we focused on microglial responses to oA{beta}42 given their disease relevance and potent cytotoxic effects. At baseline, we identified a set of TREM2-dependent genes, which corresponded to the DAM signature in mice and disease-associated signatures in humans. Additionally, loss of TREM2 resulted in increased expression of cholesterol biosynthesis genes. In response to oA{beta}42, we found that the transcriptional response was largely TREM2-independent and corresponded to a strong induction of inflammatory pathways, with TREM2 also being downregulated in control iMGLs. We identified subsets of genes and pathways that were unique to either control, such as mitochondrial DNA and RNA degradation, or TREM2 KO iMGLs, such as the senescence-associated secretory pathway and adipogenesis, suggesting some differences in gene expression driven by TREM2 in response to oA{beta}42. Given that the inflammatory response was TREM2-independent, we sought to identify signaling pathways that contributed to inflammation. Inhibition of toll-like receptor signaling significantly reduced the expression of pro-inflammatory genes and modestly increased expression of TREM2 and TREM2-dependent genes. Consistent with our transcriptional data, cytokine production and secretion in response to oA{beta}42 was significantly increased to similar levels in both controls and TREM2 KO iMGLs. 神经退行性疾病.title: Human tau compromises neuronal structural integrity in C. elegans independently of disease-associated modifications
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Tauopathies are a group of progressive neurodegenerative diseases amongst which Alzheimer's disease is the most prevalent. They typically have a late age of onset and lead to cognitive decline. Tau is a highly soluble, intrinsically disordered microtubule binding protein that aggregates in these diseases. The mechanisms by which age-associated changes alter tau functionality and compromise neuronal structural integrity remain poorly understood. Here, we show with the use of single-copy gene insertion Caenorhabditis elegans models that human tau preferentially localises to neuronal processes in the nematode, consistent with its function of binding to microtubules. The expression of tau in the nervous system led to age-associated changes in the structural integrity of the ventral nerve cord, in agreement with previous reports in touch receptor neurons. However, expressing either the disease-related P301L mutant, phosphomimic tau or co-expressing human kinases did not worsen the observed buckling phenotype. On the other hand, kinase expression was associated with the formation of tau inclusions in a small proportion of animals at old age. These results suggest that human tau induces structural alterations in C. elegans neurons independently of pathological phosphorylation or aggregation. At the same time, the late-onset formation of tau inclusions upon kinase overexpression make this new model suitable to study the sequence of events leading to tau pathology.

神经退行性疾病.title: Loss of metabolic resilience underlies maladaptive responses to lipid overload in TDP-43 proteinopathy
神经退行性疾病.abstract: INTRODUCTION Altered eating behaviour is a hallmark feature of behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD). These changes may represent a compensatory response to an underlying metabolic disturbance. However, whether increased lipid availability restores metabolic homeostasis or instead accelerates disease progression remains unknown. TDP-43 proteinopathies, which account for approximately half of FTD cases, are associated with alterations in lipid metabolism, providing a mechanistic framework to investigate the cerebral response to lipid overload. METHODS We combined clinical observations in patients with bvFTD with mechanistic studies in the physiological TardbpM323K/M323K knock-in mouse model to determine how TDP-43 dysfunction modifies the response to chronic lipid excess. RESULTS In the bvFTD cohort, elevated cholesterol and triglycerides were associated with poorer cognitive performance, while mutant mice fed a lifelong high-fat diet showed worse cognitive impairment. Multi-omics analyses of the frontal cortex revealed maladaptive metabolic rewiring characterized by impaired mitochondrial and cholesterol metabolism, lipid accumulation, and widespread remodelling of TDP-43-dependent RNA processing. These alterations affected synaptic function and neuronal communication and were accompanied by reduced cerebral glucose utilization measured by 18F-FDG PET, neurotransmitter imbalance and enhanced neuroinflammation. DISCUSSION Increased lipid availability fails to compensate for TDP-43-associated metabolic dysfunction and instead promotes maladaptive molecular and functional responses. These findings identify impaired metabolic resilience as feature of TDP-43-mediated neurodegeneration and suggest that altered eating behaviour in bvFTD may represent an unsuccessful attempt to counteract an underlying metabolic deficit rather than a purely behavioural symptom. 神经退行性疾病.title: Drug Repurposing of Rapamycin Mitigates Amyloid-β-Associated Proteotoxicity in Caenorhabditis elegans Models of Alzheimer's Disease
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Background: Alzheimers disease (AD) is the leading cause of dementia worldwide, affecting an estimated 55 million people and projected to exceed 130 million by 2050. AD is defined pathologically by extracellular accumulation of amyloid-beta (A{beta}) and intracellular neurofibrillary tangles. Currently no therapy halts the underlying neurodegeneration in AD patients. Proteotoxic accumulation of A{beta} is a central pathogenic event therefore, strategies that enhance its clearance represent a compelling therapeutic avenue. Rapamycin (sirolimus), an FDA-approved allosteric inhibitor of the mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) that relieves mTORC1-mediated suppression of autophagy, positioning it as an attractive drug-repurposing candidate for AD. However, it remains unclear whether rapamycins neuroprotection depends on directly reducing A{beta} burden or acts through A{beta}-independent mechanisms. This question, along with whether rapamycin alters specific A{beta} species, has not been systematically examined in a single, genetically tractable model. Methods/Results: Using two transgenic C. elegans models of human A{beta} expression a temperature-inducible, muscle-specific strain CL4176 and the pan-neuronal strain CL2355. We exposed C. elegans to 20 M rapamycin the lowest, nontoxic concentration to produce a protective effect. Rapamycin treatment delayed A{beta} induced paralysis in log-rank p = 0.0001) and improved crawling and swimming locomotion parameters. In the pan-neuronal CL2355 strain, rapamycin rescued the A{beta} induced chemotaxis deficit (one-way ANOVA, p = 0.008) without altering chemotaxis in the non-transgenic CL2122 control. Rapamycin also extended Kaplan Meier survival in CL2355 and preserved locomotor health span, delaying the trajectory of age related motor decline. 神经退行性疾病.title: In silico designed small molecule targets misfolded TDP-43 to rescue function and ALS pathology
神经退行性疾病.abstract: The DNA/RNA binding protein TARDBP or TDP-43 is a key driver of pathology in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), a motor neuron disease with no known cure. In >97% of sporadic ALS patients, nuclear TDP-43 in motor neurons mislocalizes and aggregates in the cellular cytoplasm (gain-of-function). A parallel reduction in nuclear TDP-43 in ALS patients leads to a loss-of-function in mRNA binding and splicing regulation. Using our machine learning platform, we discovered ACE-339, a novel, orally bioavailable small molecule that disrupts insoluble TDP-43 aggregates. Using in vitro, in vivo and in silico models, we show that ACE-339 directly targets aggregated forms of TDP-43. ACE-339 interacts directly with TDP-43 hexamers, disaggregates recombinant TDP-43 and rescues both gain- and loss-of-function phenotypes of TDP-43 in cells. ACE-339 functionally rescues TDP-43 dependent mis-splicing and synaptic activity. Lastly, ACE-339 rescues disease associated phenotypes in two independent mouse models of TDP-43 pathology. In addition, we now have a catalog of TDP-43 disaggregating compounds that are being developed further to be tested in clinical trials in patients with ALS and other TDP-43 proteinopathies.

神经退行性疾病.title: Age-associated skeletal muscle dysfunction with spinal cord pathology in an App knock-in model of Alzheimer's disease
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Skeletal muscle dysfunction is increasingly recognized in Alzheimer's disease (AD), but its pathological basis remains poorly understood. We examined age-associated muscle dysfunction together with skeletal muscle and spinal motor system alterations in male AppNL-G-F/NL-G-F knock-in (App-KI) mice, which develop age-dependent amyloid-{beta} (A{beta}) pathology without amyloid precursor protein (APP) overexpression. Middle-aged, but not adult, App-KI mice showed lower strength-related performance than age-matched wild-type mice, whereas skeletal muscle mass and myofiber cross-sectional area were preserved. General motor performance was also preserved, suggesting that the strength-related impairment did not simply reflect generalized motor dysfunction. Middle-aged App-KI mice had higher percentages of centrally nucleated fibers in the gastrocnemius and quadriceps femoris muscles. Transcriptomic and targeted expression analyses further revealed alterations in molecular profiles related to muscle development and myosin, including reduced expression of factors involved in myoblast fusion and selected myosin proteins. Despite evident cerebral A{beta} pathology, no apparent A{beta} immunoreactivity was detected in skeletal muscle. In the lumbar ventral horn, App-KI mice had fewer choline acetyltransferase-positive motor neurons, greater A{beta} deposition, and increased immunoreactivity for glial fibrillary acidic protein and ionized calcium-binding adapter molecule 1; serum interleukin-6 levels were also selectively elevated in middle-aged App-KI mice. Together, these findings indicate that age-associated reductions in strength-related performance in App-KI mice occur without overt muscle atrophy and are accompanied by histological and molecular abnormalities in skeletal muscle and pathological changes in the lumbar spinal cord. Thus, AD-related physical dysfunction may involve abnormalities in both peripheral skeletal muscle and the spinal motor system.

神经退行性疾病.title: MK-6240
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Flortaucipir and MK-6240 are two tau imaging agents currently in use for measuring neurofibrillary tangle (NFT) progression in Alzheimers disease (AD). The aims of this study were to use postmortem AD and Down syndrome (DS) brain sections to study three issues: (1) Measure binding affinity of flortaucipir and MK-6240 in AD brain sections by using [125I]IPPI; (2) Evaluate the binding characteristics of [18F]flortaucipir in AD, DS and cognitively normal (CN) brains sections and compare them with [18F]MK-6240, and (3) Assess the binding of [18F]flortaucipir in CN and Parkinsons disease (PD) brain sections to identify any off-target binding. The half-maximal inhibition (IC50) of [125I]IPPI bound to anterior cingulate (AC) in AD brain sections for flortaucipir was 2.91 nM and MK-6240 was 5.99 nM. Using frontal cortex (FCX) and temporal cortex (TCX) of AD, DS and CN brain sections, [18F]flortaucipir displayed high levels of binding in the gray matter (GM) of AD and DS. The average ratio of DSAD GM to CN GM was 15.7 in FCX, while DSAD GM to CN GM was 15.2 for the TCX. In the case of AD, average ratio of AD GM to CN GM was 12.4 in FCX, while AD GM to CN GM was 9.5 for the TCX. Binding of [18F]flortaucipir in brain section of AC from CN and PD cases did not exhibit any off-target binding to monoamine oxidase-A (MAO-A). In summary, both flortaucipir and MK-6240 exhibit similar high affinity to tau and [18F]flortaucipir exhibits higher binding compared to [18F]MK-6240 in DSAD.

神经退行性疾病.title: Integrating multiple imputation with harmonization in multisite neuroimaging data: implications for site effects and biological inference
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Multisite neuroimaging harmonization in Alzheimer's disease research with missing data has received limited attention in the literature. Here, we evaluated the performance of several harmonization methods in conjunction with multiple imputation (MI) to address missing data, using baseline [18F]flortaucipir tau positron emission tomography (PET) data from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI). We compared complete case and MICE-imputed datasets (m = 5) across the original ADNI-preprocessed data and four statistical harmonization approaches: ComBat with and without covariates, quantile normalization, and quantile regression. Weighted average standardized uptake value ratios (SUVRs) across six Braak regions were analyzed for each dataset-method combination. We assessed harmonization effectiveness using covariate-adjusted intraclass correlation coefficients and site-level pairwise differences, and evaluated biological effect preservation using Hedges' g, regression coefficients, and statistical significance for comparisons between cognitively impaired and unimpaired participants. For imputed analyses, effect sizes and regression coefficients were pooled using Rubin's rules, with statistical inference based on the pooled estimates. Post-processing harmonization reduced site-level variability compared to the original data, with method performance varying across evaluation metrics, while overall harmonization quality remained comparable after MI. Disease group differences remained statistically significant across all combinations, exhibiting a consistent regional pattern, strongest in Braak I and weakest in Braak VI. MI modestly increased effect size and coefficient estimates, with improved precision reflected by median standard error ratios below 1 (0.89 for effect sizes and 0.93 for coefficients). 神经退行性疾病.title: Partial microglial depletion attenuates Purkinje cell degeneration and reshapes both glial and inflammatory responses in a mouse model of selective neurodegeneration
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Background The microglial population contributes to the inflammatory environment during neurodegeneration. Its role in neuronal loss remains hard to distinguish from its response to injury. We investigated how early pharmacological reduction of this population affects Purkinje cell preservation, behaviour and the cerebellar glial response. Methods We administered PLX5622 to Purkinje cell degeneration (PCD) and wild-type (WT) mice from postnatal day (P) 15 to P24 and compared them with their respective untreated controls. We assessed motor coordination, spontaneous behaviours and novel-object recognition at P17, P21 and P25. At P25, we quantified regional Purkinje cell preservation, glial immunoreactivity and microglial abundance and morphology. We assessed selected transcripts in whole-cerebellum samples by reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR). Results At P25, treated PCD mice showed better motor coordination, improvements in selected spontaneous behaviours and greater novel-object discrimination. Greater Purkinje cell preservation coincided with lower glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) immunoreactivity in lobes IV-V and VIII. Microglial density decreased in all four PCD regions analysed. The territory encompassed by the processes of residual microglia expanded in both genotypes. In PCD mice, CD68-positive tissue area decreased in lobes I-II and IV-V, and the proportion of Iba1-positive area occupied by CD68 decreased in IV-V. CD45, CD16/32 and CD206 immunoreactivity decreased alongside selective reductions in immune, inflammatory and phagocytosis-associated transcripts. Treated WT mice showed early behavioural changes, including reduced novel-object discrimination. Conclusions Early PLX5622 treatment can modify the outcome of genetically driven cerebellar degeneration in PCD mice. 神经退行性疾病.title: Human Endogenous Retrovirus K RNA triggers cytoplasmic TDP-43 aggregation by initiating pathological nuclear condensates
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Cytoplasmic aggregation of the nuclear RNA-binding protein TDP-43 is a defining pathology of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) and is seen in many cases of Alzheimer's disease (AD), yet what initiates this process remains unknown. Here we identify an unexpected trigger: RNA from human endogenous retrovirus-K (HERV-K), an ancient retroviral element embedded in the human genome. Using CRISPR-engineered cells expressing Halo-tagged TDP-43 at endogenous levels, we show that HERV-K activation drives formation of cytoplasmic TDP-43 aggregates and functional loss of nuclear TDP-43, measured by aberrant cryptic exon inclusion. Surprisingly, cytoplasmic aggregation is preceded by the appearance of phosphorylated TDP-43 condensates in the nucleus, structures we term Pathological ERV-TDP-43-Associated Nuclear Spheres (PETANS). Live-cell imaging reveals that cytoplasmic inclusions originate directly from these nuclear bodies. This inverts the conventional model to suggest that pathological TDP-43 condensation begins in the nucleus, not the cytoplasm. Super-resolution imaging and structure-function mapping show that HERV-K RNA localizes within PETANS and drives their formation, with a minimal UG-rich non-coding element sufficient to induce the full cascade of nuclear and cytoplasmic pathology. Our findings establish an endogenous retroviral RNA as a direct molecular nucleator of TDP-43 proteinopathy.

神经退行性疾病.title: TDP-43 toxic gain of function links ALS, FTD and Alzheimer's disease via mis-splicing
神经退行性疾病.abstract: TDP-43 proteinopathy is a hallmark of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD). It is also common in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and limbic-predominant age-related TDP-43 encephalopathy (LATE), but its functional consequences are unclear. Here, we show that TDP-43 pathology in AD is broadly associated with splicing abnormalities. We define a conserved TDP-43-dependent splicing signature in AD that includes AD-relevant mis-spliced mRNAs such as amyloid precursor protein (APP). TDP-43 drives the formation of elongated APP isoforms across ALS, FTLD-TDP and AD, providing a mechanism for the long-standing observation of APP isoform dysregulation. APP isoform imbalance correlates with and partially mediates the association between TDP-43 pathology and A{beta} burden and is spatially associated with pTDP-43 and mis-spliced STMN2 in LATE hippocampus. Contrary to a pure nuclear loss-of-function model, mis-splicing is driven by cytoplasmic TDP-43 gain-of-function that co-sequesters splicing-regulatory RNA-binding proteins. Knockdown of TDP-43-associated RNA-binding proteins recapitulates disease-relevant splicing changes in AD and ALS/FTLD-TDP, and some of these proteins colocalize with cytoplasmic pTDP-43 in neuropathological samples. Our findings establish cytoplasmic TDP-43-driven splicing dysfunction as a key component of neurodegeneration, define disease-relevant mis-spliced mRNAs in AD and unite AD with ALS/FTLD-TDP through a shared mechanism of splicing factor sequestration.

神经退行性疾病.title: Selective Gut-Related Biomarker Profiles Define Parkinson Disease Trait and State
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Objective: Gut-brain-axis abnormalities are increasingly implicated in Parkinson disease (PD), but most studies examine individual biological compartments of this axis. We asked whether readily accessible stool and plasma-based biomarker profiles show broad or selective gut abnormalities in PD and whether the profiles associated with PD diagnosis (Trait) are the same as those associated with clinical severity (State). Methods: This cross-sectional study included 211 participants with PD and 204 healthy controls. Twenty-four stool and plasma biomarkers were organized into an overall profile, three parent domains (microbiome/dysbiosis, gut barrier/inflammation, systemic inflammation/immune activation), and eight more focused mechanistic profiles. Rank-based Global Statistical Tests (GSTs) compared PD Trait and State. Results: The overall profile showed no evidence of a PD vs. control difference (GST P=0.607; permutation P=0.521), whereas the domain of microbiome/dysbiosis differed (GST P=0.017; permutation P=0.013). Four of eight focused profiles differed nominally: microbial functional-groups, microbial functional-ratios, epithelial injury/bacterial translocation, and myeloid activation. Across PD clinical severity, overall-profile results differed (GST P=0.053; permutation P=0.037); both categories of microbiome/dysbiosis (GST P=0.023; permutation P=0.016) and microbial alpha-diversity (GST P=0.027; permutation P=0.031) differed. Interpretation: The analyses detected differences associated with PD Trait and State in selected gut-related profiles rather than a detectable overall PD-control difference. Microbiome-related profiles showed the most consistent domain findings across PD Trait and State, but they are sufficiently different to suggest that causation and progression of PD follow distinctly different gut processes. These findings refine the concept of the Parkinson gut and prioritize the microbiome for mechanistic and interventional studies.

神经退行性疾病.title: The ANKLE2-VRK1 pathway promotes neuronal resilience by preserving proteostasis during aging
神经退行性疾病.abstract: ANKLE2 is a key regulator of neural stem cell division through inhibition of the kinase VRK1, and mutations in either ANKLE2 or VRK1 cause rare neurodevelopmental disorders that impact brain growth and development. Recent evidence showing that reduced ANKLE2 activity promotes Tau aggregation in vitro suggests that ANKLE2 may also contribute to age-related neurodegenerative processes; however, its role post-development remains unknown. Using Drosophila, we show a novel role for the Ankle2-ballchen (VRK1) pathway in maintaining neuronal resilience and proteostasis. Pan-neuronal and motor neuron reduction of Ankle2 in adult animals shortens lifespan, impairs motor function and accelerates neuronal loss. Lifelong reduction produces more severe phenotypes including an upright wing posture reminiscent of Drosophila Parkinsons disease models. Mechanistically, loss of Ankle2 causes the accumulation of ubiquitinated proteins throughout the central nervous system, indicating impaired protein clearance. Ankle2 mutants have reduced proteasome activity with activation of compensatory degradative pathways, supporting this hypothesis. Loss of Ankle2 behavioral and protein accumulation phenotypes are rescued by expression of human ANKLE2, indicating neuronal ANKLE2 function is conserved between flies and humans. Importantly, VRK1/Ballchen reduction also rescues ubiquitin accumulation and behavior phenotypes caused by loss of Ankle2, demonstrating that the developmental Ankle2-VRK1 pathway is preserved and remains functionally important in aged neurons. More broadly, our findings reveal that a conserved developmental ANKLE2- VRK1 pathway is repurposed in aged neurons to maintain proteostasis and neuronal resilience, providing a mechanistic framework linking neurodevelopmental disease genes to age-associated neurodegeneration.

神经退行性疾病.title: Harmonizing amyloid PET tracers at the local level: evaluation of regional Centiloid equations
神经退行性疾病.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The Centiloid (CL) framework standardizes global amyloid-PET across radiotracers. While global scaling remains essential for participant selection, amyloid-targeting therapies require quantifying localized plaque removal. However, applying global equations regionally introduces systematic bias, particularly in subcortical structures where off-target binding alters non-specific background. METHODS: We extended the Centiloid framework regionally and voxel-wise using GAAIN datasets: Level-1 ([11C]PiB) and Level-2 paired [11C]PiB and fluorinated head-to-head cohorts ([18F]florbetaben, [18F]florbetapir, [18F]flutemetamol, and [18F]NAV4694). Level-1 defines the regional Centiloid scale using region-specific intercepts while fixing the global slope. Level-2 calibrates fluorinated tracer uptake to reference [11C]PiB SUVR using linear equations. We compared three slope-intercept models (Global, Regional-Intercept, and Regional) using information criteria and Mean Absolute Error (MAE). RESULTS: Regional-Intercept model was identified as optimal across all four radiotracers. In neocortical regions, Global and Regional-Intercept models showed high agreement across canonical lobes. In deep gray matter, global equations introduced large systematic offsets, with mean absolute conversion errors in the pallidum reaching 27.7 to 45.6 CL. The Regional-Intercept model eliminated this bias, reducing subcortical MAE on average below 15 CL while preserving a unified biological scale. DISCUSSION: Applying global Centiloid equations directly to regions introduces substantial bias in subcortical regions. With the Regional-Intercept model, the same Centiloid value corresponds to the same amyloid concentration across brain regions and radiotracers. This provides a reliable basis for cross- sectional regional evaluation, multi-tracer cohort pooling, tracking regional clearance, and mapping regional progression in clinical research.
